summary: Backend + mobile-web frontend testing executed for grouped correction storage. Backend regression and new grouped-corrections tests passed; frontend correction submission UI is blocked by modal/viewport interaction, so end-to-end submit could not be completed via Playwright.

ui_bugs.issue: In mobile web preview, modal action controls intermittently become non-tappable ('Element is outside of the viewport'), blocking stable completion of correction submit in automation.

integration_issues.flow: Generate horoscope -> enter correction mode -> edit 2 values -> review -> submit
integration_issues.issue: Generation, mode entry, and review context worked; final submit action was blocked by modal viewport behavior during automated tap.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning observed repeatedly: props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents

action_items: Fix mobile web modal interaction in correction flow so save/submit buttons remain tappable in viewport and not blocked by overlay state.
After UI fix, re-run end-to-end correction submit test to confirm POST /api/corrections succeeds from frontend.
Keep backend grouped correction schema as-is; it already passes persistence, empty-list 400, and metadata nesting checks.
critical_code_review_comments: Grouped corrections backend document shape is correct: birth_details + corrections[] + metadata including email key, with one doc per batch.
POST /api/corrections correctly returns 400 for empty corrections and does not persist data (verified by DB count checks).
server.py still uses fallback defaults for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME at module init; environment-only strictness is recommended for fail-fast consistency.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (load, generate, correction entry, two edits, review context passed; submit blocked in automation)

seed_data_creation: Temporary Mongo test documents created during pytest and cleaned up in test teardown/finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use preview URL. Backend is green for grouped corrections including empty-list validation. Frontend mobile web automation consistently hits viewport/overlay tap issues on correction modal actions; prioritize manual tap validation and modal layering fix.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: on mobile viewport (375x667), open Correction Mode, edit fields, then try modal action taps (date modal close/done or correction submit). Playwright reports element outside viewport despite force clicks. Likely root cause is modal sheet positioning/keyboard/overlay intercept in React Native Web rendering. Mitigation: ensure modal action buttons are always in visible bounds, add explicit scrollable container for sheet actions, and avoid overlapping modal states before opening review/submit.
